name: A New Creation
overview: Scripture reveals that God promises a radical transformation both in the believer and in the world to come. Isaiah proclaims the creation of new heavens and a new earth, where former things will no longer be remembered, reflecting God's sovereign renewal of all things. This renewal begins within the individual as Ezekiel describes God giving a new heart and spirit, replacing the hardened heart with one of flesh. Jesus emphasizes the necessity of being born again to enter God's kingdom, and Paul affirms that through union with Christ in baptism, believers walk in newness of life, becoming a new creation where external rites no longer matter but the inward transformation in Christ is paramount.
